title: 국회행정심판위원회규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00102:19971117:00001:part:1/1
full_text:
Addendum <National Assembly Rule No. 102, November 17, 1997>
(1) (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their adoption.
(2) (Transitional Measures) Acts performed by the former National Assembly Secretariat Administrative Appeals Committee or in relation to that Committee under the previous provisions at the time these Rules enter into force shall be deemed acts performed under these Rules.
(3) (Transitional Measures concerning Members) Members commissioned or designated under the previous provisions at the time these Rules enter into force shall be deemed commissioned or designated under these Rules for the remainder of their terms of office.
